At the airport (gate).target: Excuse me. Can you help me?
Of course. What do you need?
Where is the gate for flight SU 245 to Moscow?
At the airport (gate).native: Где выход на рейс SU 245 в Москву?

At the airport (gate).target: Let me check. Flight SU 245. That is gate B7.
At the airport (gate).native: Сейчас проверю. Рейс SU 245. Это выход B7.

At the airport (gate).target: And how do I get there?
Go straight, then turn left. You will see the signs.
At the airport (gate).native: Идите прямо, потом поверните налево. Увидите указатели.

At the airport (gate).target: No, about five minutes. Not far.
You're welcome. Have a good flight!
